sentences.text: Brachyuranochampsa was an extinct genus of crocodilian.
This animal belongs to the parent group Crocodyloidea and is closely related to the family Crocodylidae, though it is not part of that family.
The genus lived from the Campanian to the Bartonian stages, spanning between 83.6 and 39.7 million years ago.
The only robust fossil record of Brachyuranochampsa is the species B. eversolei found in the Middle Eocene of Wyoming.
